description: This file contains utility functions for creating various OpenGL textures, including 2D textures, cubemaps, and mipmapped textures, using OpenGL API calls.

methods.name: CreateSimpleTexture2D
methods.description: Creates a 2x2 RGB texture with solid colors and sets texture parameters.

methods.name: CreateSimpleTextureCubemap
methods.description: Creates a cubemap texture with six colored faces and sets texture parameters.

methods.name: CreateMipMappedTexture2D
methods.description: Creates a 256x256 RGB texture with a checkerboard pattern, generates mipmaps, and sets texture parameters.
